recognize_zh: 整個淋巴結低倍 HHV8 染色中，棕色陽性細胞沿著被膜下竇與髓質竇（sinusoidal pattern）分布，濾泡與皮質副皮質區則為陰性，顯示腫瘤以竇內浸潤為主。
features: Scanning view of a lymph node with preserved follicles and capsule
HHV8-positive cells clustered within subcapsular and medullary/intermediate sinuses
Discontinuous, patchy sinusoidal distribution of positive cell clusters
Nuclear detail not resolvable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power HHV8 (LANA-1) immunohistochemistry of a lymph node shows partially preserved architecture with residual follicles and an intact capsule. Clusters of HHV8-positive cells are distributed predominantly within the subcapsular and intranodal sinuses, whereas follicles and paracortex are negative. Individual nuclear staining patterns cannot be resolved at this magnification. Findings demonstrate a sinusoidal pattern of involvement by HHV8-positive cells, consistent with extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.vs: HHV8-positive cells are scattered plasmablasts in the mantle zones of regressed follicles, not sinus clusters.
Sinusoidal metastases are HHV8-negative and express epithelial or melanocytic markers.
